skill.name: self-hosted-funnel-launch
skill.description: Deploy Autonnel on Cloudflare Workers, Docker, or Node and launch a complete self-hosted sales funnel. Configure payments, tracking, pages, and agent access through MCP.
skill.summary: Launch and operate a self-hosted Autonnel sales funnel with deployment, integration, testing, and MCP guidance.
skill.author: autonnel

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown syntax, prose, placeholders, and bounded deployment examples. Confirmed risks involve secret generation, command-line credential exposure, an unpinned package installer, and an insufficiently constrained server-side media fetch.

remediation.issue: Secret generation examples do not work when copied into `.env`.
remediation.suggestion: Show separate shell commands that generate values, then instruct users to paste only the generated values into `.env` with restrictive file permissions.

remediation.issue: Database and admin credentials are placed in command arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Use interactive prompts, standard input, or protected temporary files. Avoid expanding database URLs or passwords into process arguments and shell history.

remediation.issue: The source installation command executes `npm create autonnel@latest`.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the package to a reviewed version and integrity-controlled lock data. Tell users to verify the package source before execution.

remediation.issue: The media import workflow does not describe server-side URL restrictions.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS, reject private and link-local addresses after DNS resolution, revalidate redirects, and enforce response size and timeout limits.

content.value_statement: Launching a production funnel requires coordinated infrastructure, integrations, pages, and testing. This skill provides a practical Autonnel workflow for deployment and agent-driven operation.
actual_capabilities: Compares Cloudflare Workers, Docker, and Node deployment paths by cost and operational responsibility.
Provides deployment steps for Workers resources, Docker Compose, containers, and source checkouts.
Orders payment, catalog, storage, email, and advertising configuration to reduce rework.
Maps landing, checkout, upsell, thank-you, and error pages into a publishable funnel.
Defines prelaunch checks for purchases, refunds, click identifiers, conversions, declined payments, and scheduled jobs.
Explains MCP authentication, write permissions, error handling, page updates, and funnel assembly order.
limitations: Requires an Autonnel installation and accounts for selected infrastructure and service providers.
Does not provision Postgres, manage backups, patch servers, or provide an uptime agreement.
Leaves payment compliance, provider configuration, and production credential management to the operator.
Commands and API behavior depend on upstream versions, so current release documentation must be verified.

use_cases.title: Deploy a Production Funnel
use_cases.description: Choose Workers or Docker, configure infrastructure, and prepare a secure Autonnel instance for launch.

use_cases.title: Validate Revenue Tracking
use_cases.description: Connect commerce, payments, email, and advertising systems, then test purchases, refunds, and conversion events.

use_cases.title: Automate Funnel Operations
use_cases.description: Connect an agent through MCP and create, verify, publish, and update funnel pages with controlled write access.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Deployment Path
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Cloudflare Workers and Docker for [traffic], [budget], and [operations capacity]. Recommend one path and list its prerequisites.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare the Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a deployment checklist for [chosen platform] using [database provider] and [domain]. Include secrets, storage, backups, health checks, and rollback preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Build and Test the Funnel
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a funnel with [offer], [checkout product], [upsell], and [tracking platforms]. Specify page order, integrations, publishing steps, and prelaunch transaction tests.

prompt_templates.title: Operate Through MCP
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an MCP workflow to update [page] in [funnel]. Require read-before-write, draft verification, explicit publishing, error checks, and least-privilege credentials.

output_examples.input: Compare deployment options for a small campaign with limited operations support.
output: Recommendation: Cloudflare Workers for low server maintenance and efficient static delivery.
Prerequisites: managed Postgres, Cloudflare account, domain, secrets, and a backup plan.
Watch first: daily cache write limits and database provider limits.

output_examples.input: Create a launch checklist for a funnel with checkout, upsell, and advertising tracking.
output: Configure the product catalog and payment provider before writing landing page claims.
Publish each page and the funnel binding separately.
Test a purchase, accepted and declined upsells, refund, receipt, error page, and conversion events.

output_examples.input: Plan a controlled MCP update to a live headline.
output_examples.output: Read the current page, change only the headline property in the draft, verify the result, publish separately, and confirm the rendered landing page.

best_practices: Pin deployment artifacts and verify current provider limits before production use.
Use separate read-only and write-enabled API keys, with one credential assigned to each agent.
Complete real purchase, refund, failure, tracking, and background-job tests before increasing traffic.
anti_patterns: Do not expose development secrets or pass production credentials through command arguments.
Do not regenerate an entire page document when changing one property.
Do not treat a successful HTTP status as proof that an MCP tool call succeeded.

faq.question: Which deployment path should I choose?
faq.answer: Use Workers for low maintenance and Docker when you need direct host control. Choose Node when modifying Autonnel itself.

faq.question: Is the Cloudflare Workers deployment completely free?
faq.answer: No. Static delivery can be inexpensive, but Postgres has separate costs and Cloudflare free resources have daily limits.

faq.question: Can the skill configure payment providers for me?
faq.answer: It explains the configuration order and validation workflow. You must supply provider accounts, credentials, compliance decisions, and production approvals.

faq.question: Can an agent edit a live funnel through MCP?
faq.answer: Yes. Use a tenant-scoped key with write access, verify drafts before publishing, and inspect tool-level errors on every response.

faq.question: Does publishing a page publish the whole funnel?
faq.answer: No. Page content and funnel bindings are published separately, so verify both states before sending traffic.

faq.question: What must be tested before launch?
faq.answer: Test a real purchase, upsell outcomes, refund, receipt, store record, click identifiers, conversion events, declined payment, and scheduled processing.
